walkthroughs.h2: shows how populations change as countries develop.
walkthroughs.body_html:
The DTM shows how populations change as countries develop.

Stage 1 high BR and DR; Stage 5 falling BR below DR.

UK is now in Stage 5.

Rostow's 5 stages describe economic take-off.

Traditional society to pre-conditions, then take-off, drive to maturity and finally mass consumption.

Critics say the model is too Western.

walkthroughs.h2: When a new factory opens, the
walkthroughs.body_html:
When a new factory opens, the multiplier effect kicks in.

Workers earn wages and spend locally, supporting shops, transport and housing.

This creates further jobs and boosts the local economy.
